notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text matches title Response Scales: Effects of Category Range on Reported Behavior and Comparative Judgments and authors Norbert Schwarz, Hans-J. Hippler, Brigitte Deutsch, and Fritz Strack. It contains the full primary report with Experiments I and II, tables, General Discussion, and references, pp. 388–395. It is not an abstract-only or secondary account. DOI is not printed in this text and was not independently verified. No PDF was supplied. The supplied study 1 description names reported TV-watching behavior and perceived importance, which have separate tests; Table 1 on p. 391 includes both. Reported own TV consumption dichotomized at two and a half hours has chi-square(1) = 7.7, p < .005 (p. 390); importance of TV has F(1,127) = 7.92, p < .006 (p. 391). A related distinct estimate-of-others outcome has F(1,127) = 8.8, p < .004 (pp. 390–391). The locator does not uniquely identify the target test. All are candidates only; no selection by numeric matching or row order. Only es_value_o is assigned; all other fields are placeholders. Literal canonical OCR uses chi^ and periods in F degrees of freedom. No metric conversion or analytic N derivation performed.
